description: This header file declares the NetworkManagerClient class used for managing network interfaces, WiFi connections, and related functionalities within the NetworkManager plugin for the WPEFramework project. It includes member functions for getting and setting interface configurations, managing WiFi SSIDs, starting/stopping WPS, and other network management tasks.

classes.name: NetworkManagerClient
classes.description: A singleton class providing an interface to manage network interfaces, WiFi connections, WPS operations, and related network functionalities within the plugin.

methods.name: NetworkManagerClient * getInstance()
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of NetworkManagerClient.

methods.name: getAvailableInterfaces
methods.description: Retrieves the list of available network interfaces.

methods.name: setPrimaryInterface
methods.description: Sets the specified interface as the primary network interface.

methods.name: setInterfaceState
methods.description: Enables or disables the specified network interface.

methods.name: setIPSettings
methods.description: Configures IP settings for a given interface.

methods.name: getPrimaryInterface
methods.description: Gets the current primary network interface.

methods.name: getDefaultInterface
methods.description: Retrieves the default network interface.

methods.name: getInterfaceState
methods.description: Checks whether a specific interface is enabled.

methods.name: getIPSettings
methods.description: Gets IP settings of a specific interface.

methods.name: getKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Lists the SSIDs known/stored by the system.

methods.name: getConnectedSSID
methods.description: Retrieves the SSID information of the currently connected WiFi.

methods.name: addToKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Adds a WiFi SSID to the list of known networks.

methods.name: removeKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Removes a WiFi SSID from the known list.

methods.name: startWifiScan
methods.description: Initiates a WiFi scan to discover nearby networks.

methods.name: isWifiScannedRecently
methods.description: Checks if WiFi scan was performed within a recent time frame.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about the device associated with the interface.

methods.name: wifiConnect
methods.description: Connects to a specified WiFi network.

methods.name: wifiDisconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the current WiFi network.

methods.name: activateKnownConnection
methods.description: Activates a previously known WiFi connection.

methods.name: getWifiState
methods.description: Retrieves the WiFi enabled/disabled state.

methods.name: getWiFiSignalQuality
methods.description: Gets the signal quality of a WiFi network.

methods.name: startWPS
methods.description: Starts the WiFi Protected Setup process.

methods.name: stopWPS
methods.description: Stops the ongoing WPS process.

methods.name: setHostname
methods.description: Sets the hostname of the device.

methods.name: modifyDefaultConnectionsConfig
methods.description: Modifies the default network connection configurations.
